title: HelloData
description:
`hello`'s reply: the protocol version the connection speaks, what this rlxd is, and
what it can do.

```json
{"protocol_version": 1, "protocol_versions": [1], "rlxd_version": "0.10.3", "capabilities": []}
```

capabilities.description: What this rlxd can do, by name. A client ignores names it does not know.

protocol_version.description: The protocol version this connection speaks from here on.

protocol_versions.description: Every protocol version this rlxd serves.
